The '''Frequency Agile subspace transceiver''' was a [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|subspace transceiver]] manufactured by [[Chedak Communications]]. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] had one installed as standard, though [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] used it sparingly despite the fact that he modified it with a [[Carbanti United Electronics/Legends|Carbanti]] [[Whistler encryption module]].

==Characteristics==
The transceiver had both video and audio pickups, and an [[Scomp link/Legends|interface port]] allowed it to connect with [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brains]] and other [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems. The antenna consisted of twelve kilometers of tightly wound, ultra-thin superconducting wire that allowed it to achieve a broadcast range of approximately forty [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]], and the receiver constantly scanned standard frequencies for [[Distress signal/Legends|distress calls]] and hails from other [[Starship/Legends|vessels]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
